imbalance_handling.logistic_regression: class_weight='balanced'; same setting as existing baseline
imbalance_handling.svm: class_weight='balanced'; same setting as existing baseline
imbalance_handling.random_forest: class_weight='balanced'; same setting as existing baseline
imbalance_handling.xgboost: compute_sample_weight('balanced', y_train) independently from each training partition; pass as classifier__sample_weight

shap: run only after CV-based model selection; stability estimates use each held-out CV fold and fold-training background
limitations: The three sklearn models already used class_weight='balanced' in the baseline implementation; those model settings are not a new treatment.
Unweighted baseline XGBoost was refit on the same ten folds to enable the paired CV comparison; these recomputed values are separately recorded.
Friedman and Wilcoxon tests on ten matched folds are reported with dependence caveat because CV training sets overlap.
Subgroup metrics are withheld when the subgroup has fewer than 30 test cases or fewer than five cases in any class.
